answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before it can transact, released only after a record of honest work. Spawning one fake identity is cheap, but funding thousands is not: like cutting basalt by hand, every copy demands real capital upfront, and misbehavior forfeits the stake. Each Sybil therefore costs as much as a coil of copper, so an attacker must buy scale identity by identity, turning a flood of fakes from free into ruinously expensive.
